blocks.text: Having attended a Hallmark movie workshop, John Wilson applies his learnings to a documentary about concrete, albeit with a dryly funny and deceptively understated tone.

blocks.text: After finding himself with too much time on his hands, documentarian Wilson attends a workshop on how to make Hallmark romcoms. It inspires him to apply the formula to a film investigating the story of concrete. Infused with Wilson’s trademark curiosity and wit, the film project introduces him to a variety of unusual people and places. The result is a wry and humane meditation on the modern world.
Doors will open 30 minutes before the screening start time.
Our house lights will remain on a low level throughout the screening, and the volume will be turned slightly down.
You will be able to leave the auditorium and return during the screening.
You will be able to make noise.
We will provide a quiet space for you to use near the auditorium.
You are welcome to take refreshments into the cinema but no hot food please. For information on BFI Bar & Kitchen and BFI Riverfront please see our food and drink page .
